create_SpanningTreeNonProjectiveCRF: create a SpanningTreeNonProjectiveCRF distribution from log-potentials for non-projective dependency parsing
run_SpanningTreeNonProjectiveCRF_argmax: run argmax on a SpanningTreeNonProjectiveCRF to find the maximum spanning tree as an adjacency matrix
run_SpanningTreeNonProjectiveCRF_log_par: run log_partition on a SpanningTreeNonProjectiveCRF to compute the log-partition function via Laplacian determinant
sample_SpanningTreeNonProjectiveCRF: sample from a SpanningTreeNonProjectiveCRF using Colbourn or Wilson's algorithm with a JAX random key
run_SpanningTreeNonProjectiveCRF_top_k: run top_k on a SpanningTreeNonProjectiveCRF to approximate the k highest-scoring spanning trees via beam search
